title: MLB 2005 (Sony PlayStation 2, 2004) - Tested Works 989 Sports
descriptionText:
This is a great opportunity to own a classic baseball game, MLB 2005 for Sony PlayStation 2. This game is perfect for all ages with its E-Everyone rating. It belongs to the Mlb Series and was published by Sony Computer Entertainment in 2005. 

The game comes with a manual and is a unit type game. It is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and was manufactured in the United States. This sports game is a great addition to your collection and is sure to provide hours of entertainment.
